title: DeliveryObservation
description: Append-only post-handoff transport evidence tied to one exact durable delivery attempt. Observations do not mutate receipt or outbox lifecycle state.

sequence.description: Monotonic append sequence within the delivery_observations table.

observation_id.description: Deterministic idempotency identifier for this transport observation.

event_id.description: Canonical event associated with the delivery attempt.

delivery_plan_id.description: Authoritative delivery-plan identity from the correlated outbox row.

target_adapter.description: Adapter instance that emitted the transport observation.

target_channel.description: MEDRE route target channel from the correlated outbox row.

native_channel_id.description: Transport-native channel or address reported by the adapter; not a lifecycle correlation key.

outbox_id.description: Durable outbox identity for the exact delivery attempt.

adapter_message_id.description: Native message identifier associated with the observation, when available.

state.description: Terminal transport state reported after MEDRE handoff.

confirmation_level.description: Evidence strength independent from provider state terminology.

error.description: Human-readable terminal error context when applicable.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp when core received the transport observation.
